interpretation: Official documentation establishes a supported Vulkan-disable control and prior fixes to that control. Original runtime shows both SwiftShader Vulkan and GLES initialization. These facts justify a single-variable diagnostic comparison, but do not identify the SIGSEGV cause. Current 37.3.10 notes also list generic SIGSEGV and unreachable-devtools fixes; without a matching native stack these are not identified as this failure. Chrome documentation is relevant background, not proof of the particular WebView backend.
